_fixture: M10 Orion fan-out scene (Pulsar #64 / pivot, ADR 003 Amendment 5 §A5.3 + Amendment 4 §A4.2 + Amendment 2 §A2.3 / F2). This is NOT the OBS scene graph the monitor_capture sources live in (those are created over obs-websocket by m10_setup.py against pulsar.exe). This is the ORION show scene with TWO jobs. (1) C-FANOUT: it DECLARES the scene_control leaf path so Orion's Inbox.Write fans the Blue delta out to the /show/stream subscribers. Orion's sceneAcceptsPath (Orion/internal/adapters/inbox.go) drops any leaf no loaded scene declares in defaults / operator_inputs / bindings.target_paths; so the active M10 scene MUST declare __inputs.blue.m10-scene-control.scene_control (operator_inputs below) or the switch silently no-ops. (2) RENDER ROOT: its render root is the `wipe-cover` AUTHORING element (Amendment 5 §A5.3). Orion's lowerWipeCover (Orion/internal/compiler/lower_wipe_cover.go, #65) intercepts kind:'wipe-cover' at lowering time and lowers it to a keyframed full-screen frame (RenderNode.keyframes keyed on the declared leaf, fill #C81E5A franc magenta, opacity 0->1 reveal ->1 hold ->0 retract). The authoring props are read off node.Props by name EXACTLY: leaf / reveal_ms / hold_ms / retract_ms / fill (fill optional, defaults to the same magenta). In LSML 1.1 node form these props are SPREAD at the node's top level (matching Orion's EmitLSML lsmlNode: node[k]=raw), NOT nested under a `props` object. The leaf path keys the replay (keyframes.key), so a scene_control delta remounts the KeyframePlayer and re-plays reveal->hold->retract (the M9 reactive path). The keyframes block lives ONLY on the lowered Root; the authoring node keeps kind:'wipe-cover' for EmitLSML, so the C4 LSML content-hash is unperturbed (A5.5). The operator_inputs.default below is a scene_control VALUE in the re-frozen Amendment 4 OVERLAY shape (target_scene + overlay{kind,reveal_ms,hold_ms,retract_ms} + cut_at_ms) that Orion seeds on boot and that MUST round-trip the frozen scene_control contract (scripts/contracts/scene_control/) — the prior OBS-native action/transition shape is rejected. This scene renders nothing OBS-visible itself (the on-air composition is the two OBS monitor_capture scenes + the Solar/CEF overlay above them); the wipe-cover render root is what Solar paints as the opaque cover. scene_version is a zeroed placeholder the harness stamps with the real content hash (m9 parity).
